test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is Optical Distribution Network (ODN)?

options.text: The physical fibres that distribute signals to users in a telecommunications network.
The physical fibres that distribute signals to users in an electronic circuit.
The physical fibre and optical devices that distribute signals to users in a telecommunications network.
The optical devices that cannot distribute signals.

solution:
The correct answer is** The physical fibre and optical devices that distribute signals to users in a telecommunications network.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Optical Distribution Network (ODN)** is a key segment of fiber-based networks, connecting the central office and terminal user.
 
• Its design, construction process and operational management features are strategic for operators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Costs associated to the ODN represent about 60% of the total cost.
 
• Which of them are needed for connecting a **household to an FTTx network, and the ODN **needs to be easy to expand in order to cover new households in the long run.
